messages:
deploy-bot: Starting percent rollout: billing-service v5.4.0 -> 4% traffic in us-east-1. change-window 2026-03-27 16:00-16:30 UTC. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/billing/5.4.0

vivian: quick check: small spike in invoice-generation latency and a couple 500s. p99 ~380ms (baseline 150ms).

marco: tracing shows `invoice-builder` retries increasing; looks related to new retry backoff in v5.4.0. Could be retry loop amplification under error.

ops-bot: Alert: billing-service us-east-1 error-rate exceeded soft threshold (policy=BILL-5xx). Recommend manual pause for triage.

release-admin: recommend pin cohort and collect traces before broader rollback. Can someone issue a pause?

marco: running hold/pin now: `/release pause service=billing-service cohort=percent-rollout version=v5.3.9 reason="500s / retry amplification"`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 4%. Cohort pinned to v5.3.9. action_id=rl-4999991234-pause

ops-bot: Routing update confirmed. 4% cohort now served by v5.3.9. Telemetry backfill in ~45s.

vivian: after pin, 5xx count falling toward baseline and p99 trending down to ~160ms. Good rollback signal.

marco: I'll triage retry logic and post a short summary in 25m. If confirmed, propose patch to reduce retry cap + jitter and then re-run a 0.5% probe behind a feature flag.

oncall: monitoring the change-window. escalate to incident if thresholds breach again.

release-admin: updating release notes with pause rationale and scheduling a 15m follow-up at 16:10 UTC. Keeping thread open for triage updates. :white_check_mark:
